steps.command: if [ -f backend/requirements.txt ]; then python3 -m pip install -q --only-binary=:all: -r backend/requirements.txt; fi
steps.why: The backend's Python dependencies were never installed, which causes the missing google.genai import. Wheels only, so no build scripts run.

backend/mcp_server.py uses mcp.server.fastmcp, which was removed in mcp 2.x, so mcp must be pinned below 2. google-genai provides `from google import genai`. pytest-asyncio is needed by the async tests.
